entries.scope: Seven semantic feature decisions and eleven proof updates at immutable public commits
entries.rationale: Accept only evidenced starts, execution and completion; distinguish later security requirements from historical closure, verify archive-only moves and explain every incomplete case and unknown mode.
readerPaths: README -> methodology -> semantic decisions -> exact proof refs and remaining completion gaps
entries.navigationImpact: Add a dated semantic-review link to the existing methodology entrypoint; preserve all previous review records.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in the review report; machine-readable proof metadata remains language-neutral with explicit English reasons.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Immutable public spec/tasks/state comparison, eight archive content hashes, three independently confirmed provider merges, source-tree campaign inventory, registry validation and canonical native PR CI.
entries.risk: Do not equate planning with implementation, task markers with acceptance, missing autonomous state with manual work, or historical completion with fulfillment of later security obligations.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Changed evidence, task/run state, explicit mode proof, current security obligations or a newly reviewed completion chain.

entries.scope: Derived bilingual statistics, queue, publication hashes, project statistics and profile export
entries.rationale: Regenerate all publication surfaces from the reviewed register and unchanged approved private aggregate; update the reproducible Profile-2 block from committed text and Git history.
readerPaths: Published README table -> method -> register and dated review -> unresolved completion proof
entries.canonicalSource: docs/spec-kit-runs/registry.json and approved snapshot/private aggregate; docs/project-statistics.config.json and Git history for Profile 2
entries.navigationImpact: Existing marked README blocks and table links remain; the profile imports only merged Level-0 output.
entries.languageStrategy: German README/table with equivalent English partners and explicit public/private observation dates.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Canonical fixture tests, snapshot/register/aggregate validation, renderer drift checks, queue and count reconciliation, README marker preservation and exact-head native CI.
entries.risk: Only the manifest-bound Home README is synchronized. Proofs remain source-only. The personal profile requires its separate import PR, preserved MOTD and green CI. No private individual evidence is published.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Registry classifications, source/private aggregate changes, counting or rendering rules, distribution or profile import contract changes.
